rapport_notes: Warm and sympathetic when customer disclosed a separation/move-to-storage situation, but otherwise transactional.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "I see that. Well, I'm sorry to hear... But yeah, definitely we can help you with your concern" — acknowledged the separation with no follow-up, straight pivot to storage-unit logistics.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we will only bill you for the actual hours rendered, so I will estimate this between 3:00 to four hours"

coaching_note: Never asks the agenda/concerns question or does quid-pro-quo framing, and skips the Sheet 1/2 differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) entirely.
